###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to fix the screenshots and the Test 2 case.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update, @FAzabmpc! Please make the before/after screenshots precise as described in [the guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots), showing the same state in each pair. Your Test 2 notes say a collapsed message that is then muted still shows expanded after reveal, so please fix that case, and add a test if you've checked that box.
```
